title: Ronda in a day.
text:
The visit to the Olive farm is all about tasting different olive oils, none about the production as I was led to believe.  I could skip this part. 
The white villages are amazing.
The hike down half way to see the Ronda bridge was worth it. 
I do recommend this tour although it makes for a long day, almost 12 hours.
author: PETER_D

title: A very nice visit
text:
We had a great visit . The white villages and the olive oil production place were awesome .
We really appreciate our guide Pia, she was extremely knowledgeable and gave some very interesting explanations during the entire trip. Also her English is perfect so she is easy to understand. Thank you Pia as well as thank you to our driver Miguel who kept us safe in those mountains roads .
author: Catherine B

title: Perfect!
text:
Easy pickup, guide (Catherine) was smiling and competent.
Breathtaking landscapes, magnificent villages. We were blown away!
author: Paradise30205448722

title: Thank you Maria Rodriguez
text: We enjoyed every single minute.Our guide Maria was absolutely fantastic with a lot of amazing tips.Pick point was very easy to find and the transport was very comfortable.
author: 920giorgoss

title: Picturesque and memorable.
text: A fun, interesting trip into the mountains of the White Villages and Ronda. It was so informative and you truly feel like you’re experiencing life in these beautiful, picturesque mountain villages. We stopped for lunch in a most serene restaurant and had an exquisite lunch, of their local menu. Can’t recommend this enough!!
author: Rosamaria_G

title: I highly recommend this tour in Spanish/English
text: I loved the tour and the time spent in each small town, the Spanish guide (Jerez) Iván was wonderful narrating the history of the towns and Spain, logistics, etc. in two languages: English and Spanish. In addition to being very attentive to the needs of the tourists, he helped me recover my tripod that I forgot in one of the places we arrived at - Thanks Iván!
author: 857ednav

title: The tour was very well...
text:
The tour was very well organized and the guides very well informed. 
It was a bit difficult to see ronda in such a small period of time, so the scavengerhunt like map was very helpful.

title: I never heard a word, but I learned more than most of the other tour participants.
text: My wife and I travel the world 4 to 6 months out of the year. We have had numerous tours and numerous guides throughout the last 10 years. Our guide, Ivan, was the best guide I have had in those 10 years. I am deaf and I never get to hear one word from our guides. I read lips and my wife told Ivan before we even got to the bus. He had me sit directly across the aisle from him. He spoke Spanish first (which I can’t read) and English second. He always started the English portion with the word “so” drawn out. title: A fantastic day
text: This was an amazing experience. There were only 4 of us on the trip and we were picked up close to our hotel. Our guide and driver was fantastic. Very friendly and knowledgeable. His English was excellent and he was on time for all pick ups which was brilliant. The trip was amazing, the white villages were truly stunning, the views are breathtaking and having time to look around the village was lovely.
